_precondition: Captured after a genuine Tab keypress. A programmatic .focus() does not satisfy :focus-visible and would have reported a missing focus ring on a site that has one.

verdict.note_thickness: 1.6px is thin; SC 2.4.13 (AAA) asks for a 2px-equivalent perimeter. Not an AA failure, but it reads as a weak indicator.
verdict.semantics: FAIL — <div tabindex="0"> with no role. Screen readers announce it as text, and keyboard activation is not wired for free. Use a real <a> or <button>, or add an explicit role plus key handlers.
